title: DeltaEvolve: Accelerating Scientific Discovery through Momentum-Driven Evolution

mechanism.domainTask: Scientific and algorithmic program discovery across five domains
mechanism.populationDetail: Configuration lists three islands and a population of 40; method emphasizes a node database, but island internals are not fully specified.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Configuration lists archive size 20 and top-k elites; MAP-Elites cells select diverse prompt references, but archive admission is not described.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Database stores program, score, delta summary, and delta plan; island and archive update semantics remain underspecified.
mechanism.generationDetail: One sampled parent program is edited, with historical semantic-delta plans supplying conceptual directions; changes may alter the overall algorithm.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Objective is scored after executable-code testing; prompt includes feedback and qualitative improved/degraded delta outcome.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: One full-code parent is distinct from five rendered delta references; island-local versus global sampling is not stated.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Three-level semantic-delta database and progressive disclosure of historical change plans as generation context.
